editorial:
Imagine waking up and realizing your life is being torn apart by people you thought were your friends. You will feel the tension immediately as you follow a group of students caught in a nasty cycle of bullying and revenge. The movie does a great job of making you feel the stress of the main characters as they try to survive the social war. It feels like a high-stakes game where one wrong move could ruin everything, and the moody atmosphere keeps you on the edge of your seat from the start.

What really makes this work is the acting, which feels totally real and not like a cheesy soap opera. The pacing is quick, though some of the middle parts drag a bit. You should definitely check this out if you love stories about secrets and school drama.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the main character finally exposes the ringleader during a big school event. You see the bullies lose their power as their own secrets are leaked to the whole school. The twist is that the person helping the hero was actually the one who started the drama years ago. In the end, the characters learn that revenge does not fix the pain, and they all move on to start over.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gripping school dramas and stories about standing up to bullies.
